maria_ops: Heads up — scheduling a thermal fan recalibration in az2 (eu-west2) next Tue 2026-04-06 01:00-03:00 UTC. We'll do cohort cordon + rolling GPU reboots across 4 racks. Expect transient throughput drops and some tail latency while caches warm.
kevin_infra: What's the blast radius for hosted vs Dedicated?
anika_runtime: Also: how are we handling KV/prefix cache warmup and batchers? Those will spike p95 if we coldstart too many nodes.
maria_ops: Plan summary: cordon one 8-node cohort at a time, reboot + calibrate fans, wait ~20m for health + cache warmup, then move to next cohort. Canary on 2 nodes first. Warmup scripts after node comes back.
devex_taylor: :wave: Need to notify Dedicated customers — who's owning customer comms?
ben_platform: I'll own the dedicated notify + status page updates. Quick cost tradeoff: standby reserved capacity for the window vs spot backfill. Standby ~+$1.2k for full coverage, spot mix ~+$300 but higher preempt risk and potential tail errors.
maria_ops: Decision: spot backfill for non-SLA traffic; standby for customers flagged as "no-preempt" (we'll mark C-112 and C-87). Ben please create standby for those clusters.
kevin_infra: Can we shorten the window? Fans calibrate per-rack ~15-18m; leaving 20m safety between cohorts is required for NVLink/fan settle checks. Don't compress.
anika_runtime: Warmup command we'll run after cohort returns: `scripts/warmup_pool.sh --pool=az2-cohort-1 --model=gpt-medium --duration=15m`. Also prime KV prefix cache and the batching workers.
sre_oncall_bot: sre-oncall:page: - @oncall team please ack. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/thermal-fan-calibration
josh_oncall: Acked. I'll monitor GPU temp, NVLink error counters, and 5xx/429 surge. Alerts: gpu_temp>85C for >2m, nvlink_errors>0, p50_gen_latency>1.2s.
maria_ops: Networking note: BGP egress path switch scheduled at 01:10 UTC to move traffic to standby/backfill pools — net will coordinate to avoid flaps.
ben_platform: Backfill strategy: use spot for pools that are tagged `best-effort:true`. For critical pools, put two racks into standby with reserved capacity. Canary and rollback plan documented.
devex_taylor: I'll send a short status blurb to status.redwood.com 30m before each cohort and a DM to major customers.
maria_ops: Safe command snippets for operators: `kubectl cordon <node>` then `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120` — avoid `--force` unless hardware is stuck. After node ready: `./tools/warm_cache.sh --model gpt-medium`.
ben_platform: After first cohort completes run smoke load: 5k requests sampling p95 and token quality check. If regression >5% we fallback to alternate model variant and escalate.
josh_oncall: I'll stay on pager until 04:00 UTC. Notifying rotations now.
maria_ops: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll post the final timeline + ticket IDs in ~2 hours."
